intelligence.essence: A Smart List IS the feature: lists of notes, lists of contacts, lists of your worlds, lists of your notes. The tools live WHERE the citizen inputs (Your Notes entry, adding a contact): a PLUS button to create a list; tag/add the item to a list; images; everything saved to the Smart Vault for that day. AUTO-ORGANIZE: the system organizes their notes, smart notes and contacts for them — they input, we organize. A note is saved for that day. YOUR WORLDS in the main Hub is the TABLE OF CONTENTS for all the smart lists — go there, find all your lists, tap the list you want (contacts, smart notes, your notes, worlds), it opens and shows every item in that list. Simple access is the point.
